items.title: China's ability to hit Australia with missiles 'real and growing'
items.description: New analysis warns that China's military is developing a "real and growing" ability to hit the Australian mainland with missiles, and can already threaten Australia's trade routes, subsea cables and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Police treating deaths of man and girl at Sydney bay as murder-suicide
items.description: Investigators are trying to determine what led to a suspected murder-suicide on Saturday, after the bodies of a father and young child were recovered from a bay off Concord.

items.title: Live: 'Chaotic weather' forecast for White House UFC event
items.description: As the fighters prepare for their South Lawn debuts, the Weather Channel is predicting heavy rain and potential thunderstorms. Follow live.

items.title: Picturesque islands in WA's north set to become transport hubs after $20m sale
items.description: A Kimberley iron ore mine with idyllic views across a tropical sea will close after 70 years of operation as a new phase begins for offshore oil and gas.

items.title: Outbreak of this Victorian-era disease labelled a 'health disaster and tragedy'
items.description: Forty-two babies in Australia died from congenital syphilis between 2011 and 2025, with the outbreak driving health workers into communities to raise awareness of the old-world disease.

items.title: Live: US-Iran ceasefire to include Lebanon as Trump says 'let the oil flow'
items.description: Pakistan, which has been negotiating peace talks between the US and Iran, says a deal to end the war has been agreed. Follow live.

items.title: 'Let them talk': Socceroos hero bites back at claim Türkiye 'dominated'
items.description: Socceroos goalscoring hero Nestory Irankunda says Türkiye could not back up their talk, despite one of its stars claiming post-game Australia had been "dominated".

items.title: Iran briefing: Before the ceasefire, Trump resumed dropping f-bombs
items.description: Donald Trump is reported to unleash another expletive-laden outburst at Benjamin Netanyahu over Israeli strikes as the US and Iran finalise a peace deal.

items.title: 'Absolutely terrified': Scolyer's doctor reveals fears of experimental therapy
items.description: Just 11 weeks before he died, Richard Scolyer cycled 500km in four days. In his last major TV interview, the celebrated pathologist tells Australian Story the secret to a fulfilling life and his doctor reveals the huge risks he took to try new brain cancer treatment.

items.title: Live: Feisty Côte d'Ivoire-Ecuador clash threatens to boil over
items.description: Côte d'Ivoire and Ecuador face off after Japan finds a late leveller against the Netherlands and World Cup debutant Curaçao enjoys a magical moment in the midst of a drubbing. Follow live.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
